_how_to_fill: Anthropic doesn't publish Claude plan limits as token counts, so calibrate once: note the weekly usage % on claude.ai > Settings > Usage just before a daily run (19:54 SGT) and just after it finishes, and put the difference below. The site then shows your weekly and monthly share.

api_rates_usd_per_mtok._note: Published API list prices for the model the scheduled run uses. Cache writes are at the 1-hour rate Claude Code uses on subscriptions. Only for estimating; a plan doesn't bill per token.
